Lemma
[Variation formula for the Riemann tensor] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0283, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0284, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0285 1. ch14:14.27\group Curvature Variations

If $\partial _sg_{ij}=-2h_{ij}$, then \[ \partial _sR_{ijkl} =( abla ^2\mathbin \odot h)_{ijkl} - rac12\left( R_{qjkl}h_{iq}+R_{iqkl}h_{jq}+R_{ijq\ell }h_{kq}+R_{ijkq}h_{\ell q} ight), \] where $ abla ^2_{ij}= frac 12( abla _i abla _j+ abla _j abla _i)$ and $\odot $ is the Kulkarni--Nomizu product.
Proof

\sketch Differentiating the Levi–Civita connection and then the curvature gives

\[ \partial _sR_{ijkl} = abla _i abla _\ell h_{jk}+ abla _j abla _kh_{i\ell } - abla _i abla _kh_{j\ell }- abla _j abla _\ell h_{ik} -R^q{}_{ijk}h_{q\ell }+R^q{}_{ij\ell }h_{kq}. \]

Commute each pair of derivatives to replace it by its symmetrization. The commutators contribute curvature contracted with $h$. The first Bianchi identity combines these contractions into the four terms displayed in the statement, while the four symmetrized Hessian terms are precisely $ abla ^2\mathbin \odot h$.

□
